tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Claims for other taxes: Tata Communications (Spain) S.L. (“TC Spain”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tata Communications Limited, received an initial assessment order, dated 20 June 2019, from the Spanish Tax Agency (“STA”), whereby the refund of an input VAT claimed by the Company had been denied by STA and a sum of EUR 15,440,044.62 towards VAT and interest thereupon had been demanded, plus a penalty of EUR 18,102,272.48 was imposed. TC Spain filed counter-arguments in response to the initial assessment, subsequent to which, STA issued a final assessment order dated 27 August 2019 demanding VAT and interest of EUR 15,505,607.73. TC Spain then filed its notice of intention to appeal the final VAT assessment in the Central Administrative Court (TEAC) in Spain, post which the STA issued its final penalty assessment on 28 November 2019 for the amount of EUR 18,102,272.48, which was also appealed against by TC Spain. On 29 March 2022, TEAC rendered a decision upholding the assessment and penalty issued against TC Spain. TC Spain has filed a notice of appeal of the TEAC determination before the National Court on 24 May 2022 and awaits the National Court’s decision. The Company has made necessary disclosures on the matter as part of the notes to accounts in its quarterly and annual consolidated financial results. Name of subsidiary - Tata Communications (Spain) S.L. Court / Tribunal / Agency before which the matter is pending - National Court, Spain Expected financial implications - Rs. 298.95 crores (Final Assessment by the STA: EUR15,505,607.73; Final Penalty Assessment by the STA: EUR18,102,272.482)
tax_litigation.status: There is no change in the status of the case from the previous disclosure.

tax_litigation.status: Claims for taxes on income on account of: 1. Audit of international telecommunications services by modifying the applied transfer pricing method. Years under audit FY 2007-08 to FY 2017-18. The Company has filed objections before Federal and Provincial Authorities and the matter is pending at Appeals Division. Further, the Company is also seeking certainty through alternative dispute resolution mechanism. 2. Audit of support services rendered for Signaling business by rejecting transfer pricing method applied and proposing to apply Profit Split method. Years under audit FY 2007-08 to FY 2017-18. Tata Communications (Canada) Ltd. and Canada Revenue Agency have reached an agreement in principle on June 26, 2025 to settle the issue and have begun drafting the formal settlement documents, including a settlement agreement and partial consent to judgment, which will implement the in-principal settlement. The parties do not have a definitive timeline for the completion of the aforementioned documentation. An update will be submitted to the Tax Court of Canada on or before March 31, 2026. No material impact on the financials of the Company is expected currently. Expected financial implications - Rs 1835.56 crores (USD 204.31 Mn at the closing rate of Rs. 89.84150 / USD as on 31 December 2025)

Tata Communications (Canada) Ltd. and Canada Revenue Agency have reached an agreement in principle on June 26, 2025 to settle the issue and have begun drafting the formal settlement documents, including a settlement agreement and partial consent to judgment, which will implement the in-principal settlement. The parties do not have a definitive timeline for the completion of the aforementioned documentation. An update will be submitted to the Tax Court of Canada on or before March 31, 2026. No material impact on the financials of the Company is expected currently. Expected financial implications - Rs 1835.56 crores (USD 204.31 Mn at the closing rate of Rs. 89.84150 / USD as on 31 December 2025)

operating_notes.text: Digital portfolio revenue grew 19.2% YoY to ₹2,909 Cr in Q4FY26 and 16.7% to ₹10,621 Cr in FY26.
Data services revenue rose 11.4% YoY to ₹5,704.61 Cr in Q4FY26, with segment result of ₹346.87 Cr.
FY26 capex was ₹2,433.18 Cr, up 10.3% YoY, against operating cash flow of ₹4,479.1 Cr.
Issued ₹750 Cr Commercial Paper at 6.12% p.a. discount, maturing July 23, 2026.
Acquired 26% of Clean Max Yuhdul SPV for ₹26,000 to enhance renewable energy footprint in Karnataka through captive consumption.
TComm Turkey incorporated in Turkey on May 21, 2026, to provide IoT system integration and IT consultation.
Issued ₹300 Cr Commercial Paper at 7.27% p.a. discount, maturing August 21, 2026.
Fire incident occurred at a leased premises at Next-Gen Tower, Greater Kailash-1, New Delhi; business continuity protocols activated.
Digital portfolio revenue was ₹3,016 Cr in Q2FY27, up 18.6% YoY, with digital margins at -3.6%.
DoT demand notices aggregate ₹7,844.57 Cr for FY2005-06 to FY2024-25; ₹7,513.71 Cr is carried as contingent liability net of ₹54.18 Cr provision.
Board approved transfer of Kaleyra, Inc. shareholding to Tata Communications (Netherlands) B.V. at fair market value.
Digital portfolio margin was -3.6% in Q2FY27 (loss ₹107 Cr), against -6.9% in Q1FY27 and -9.7% in FY25.
Company cites 300 Fortune 500 and 380 ET 500 customers and 70% of India's live financial services data traffic.
AI stack built on GPU infrastructure in India and Commotion; cited deployments include 700+ agents live and 600K+ voice AI minutes a month.
National Court of Spain annulled a EUR 15,505,607.73 VAT demand and EUR 18,102,272.48 penalty on subsidiary Tata Communications (Spain) S.L.; judgment subject to appeal.
Issued and allotted ₹300 Cr Commercial Paper at 6.75% p.a. maturing on November 23, 2026.
Announced ₹4,350 Cr investment to add ~6 Pbps network capacity over FY 2030 – FY 2036.
Completed transfer of Kaleyra, Inc. to TCNL and its subsequent merger into Kaleyra US Inc.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,554.15 Cr (+9.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹263.24 Cr (-74.7% YoY).
Zubin Adil Patel, CFO of Tata Communications Limited, uploaded the earnings call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 results on April 22, 2026.
Tata Communications issued and allotted ₹750 Cr of Commercial Paper at a 6.12% discount rate, maturing in July 2026.
Tata Communications uploaded the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call held on April 22, 2026.
Tata Communications signed an agreement to acquire a 26% stake in Clean Max Yuhdul Private Limited for ₹26,000 to source captive renewable energy for its Karnataka offices.
Incorporated TComm Turkey Dijital Çözümler Limited Şirketi as a wholly owned step-down subsidiary in Turkey on May 21, 2026.
Tata Communications allotted ₹300 Cr of Commercial Paper at a 7.27% discount rate, maturing in August 2026.
Tata Communications reported a fire incident at its leased premises in Greater Kailash, New Delhi, activating business continuity protocols.
Tata Communications Limited, via Zubin Adil Patel, rescheduled Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings call from 5:30 PM IST to 4:00 PM IST on October 15, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,687.89 Cr (+9.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹341.03 Cr (+86.3% YoY).
2026-10-15: Q2FY27 earnings-call presentation showed the digital portfolio loss narrowing to ₹107 Cr (margin -3.6%) from ₹886 Cr in Q1FY27, with no numeric guidance.
Recording of the earnings call held via webinar on Thursday, October 15, 2026 at 4:00 pm IST has been uploaded on the company website.
2026-10-21: National Court of Spain ruled in favour of subsidiary TC Spain, annulling the TEAC resolution, a EUR 15,505,607.73 VAT demand and a EUR 18,102,272.48 penalty; judgment not final.
Tata Communications issued and listed a ₹300 Cr Commercial Paper maturing on November 23, 2026.
2026-10-26: Tata Communications announced a planned ₹4,350 Cr (USD 400-450 million) investment to build ~6 Pbps of AI-ready network capacity across 10,000 km by FY 2036.
Tata Communications completed the transfer of Kaleyra, Inc. to TCNL and its subsequent merger into Kaleyra US Inc. on October 31, 2026.
